methodological_note: The 0.05 dB comparison threshold used to declare PASS was set by the implementer while writing this script, not pre-registered in a separate experiment specification before execution. The defensible claim is the measured fact: under frozen, comparable execution conditions (identical baselines, both signals valid), the memory-informed decision (+0.08) produced a +0.1547 dB larger tail_rms_db improvement than the control decision (+0.05). Whether +0.1547 dB constitutes 'significant' by some independent criterion was not established in advance.
